prompts.jewel_prompt: Use case: game sprite sheet, precise-object-edit. Reference is the approved jewel playing-card concept. Extract and refine the FOUR HIGH JEWELRY SUIT BROOCH designs into ONE production sprite sheet, without ANY playing card shapes, text, ranks or background. Square 2048x2048 canvas, truly TRANSPARENT RGBA background (not a checkerboard drawn into pixels, not white, not green). Exactly four separate objects arranged in a strict 2x2 equal-cell grid: top-left SAPPHIRE BLACK SPADE brooch, top-right RUBY RED HEART brooch, bottom-left ORANGE RED RHOMBUS DIAMOND SUIT brooch, bottom-right EMERALD GREEN CLUB brooch. Each one centered in its own quadrant, similar visual size, complete metalwork visible, wide completely transparent gutters and 12% transparent inset within its cell; no inter-cell overlap. Match the reference high jewelry design faithfully: brilliant crisp gemstone facets, warm champagne gold claw mounts and delicate metal gallery, tiny white diamond pave around each iconic silhouette, no cartoon treatment of jewels. Spade conventional two lobes, pointed top and flared stem. Heart two round lobes and pointed bottom. Diamond four-point elongated rhombus. Club exactly three ROUND lobes and flared stem, not leaves. This is delicate wearable finished jewelry, not bare gemstones. Front facing upright, same studio lighting from upper left, restrained realistic highlights, minimal attached ambient shading but NO detached cast shadow, no floor, no card, no ornamental background, no chains. Do not include any numbers, words, borders, labels, colored squares, or texture outside object silhouettes. This sheet will be mechanically split into four transparent sprites for code composition.
prompts.jewel_key_prompt: Edit ONLY the background of this jewelry sheet. Preserve exactly every pixel-level jewelry design, gem color, metalwork and positioning of the four brooches. Replace ALL gray checkerboard pattern outside the jewels, including between jewels and inside open metalwork gaps, with uniform pure hot magenta RGB(255,0,255), hexadecimal #FF00FF. Absolutely flat SOLID MAGENTA BACKGROUND, no gradient, no checkerboard, no shadow cast onto background. Magenta is a temporary chroma-key plate for mechanical alpha extraction. No magenta reflection or magenta spill in jewelry: keep original cool sapphire, scarlet ruby, orange garnet, green emerald, gold, white diamonds intact. No changes to jewels, no text, no labels, no new objects. Four isolated brooches in original 2x2 layout with wide margins and gutters.
prompts.court_spade_prompt: Use case: game character sprite sheet. Reference image 1 is original classic poker atlas, identity reference: spade JACK QUEEN KING are first three cards in second row. Reference image 2 is previous noble costume concept; use ONLY clothing richness and character accessories, radically change drawing style. Make ONE wide landscape sprite sheet containing exactly THREE SEPARATE WAIST-UP CARTOON NOBLE CHARACTERS in strict equal-width columns, left to right SPADE JACK, SPADE QUEEN, SPADE KING. No cards, no letters. Strong clearly CARTOON 2D illustration: clean confident dark ink contours, appealing stylized faces, slightly oversized heads, expressive eyes and simplified noses, flat rich base colors and 2-3 crisp cel-shading tones, elegant graphic shapes. NOT realistic, NOT photograph, NOT painterly realistic skin, NOT 3D render, NOT anime, not toddler chibi. Ornate ceremonial clothing still sumptuous but embroidery simplified into readable gold graphic motifs. Preserve original classic spade identities: JACK young clean-shaven blond wavy shoulder-length hair, exact side profile looking RIGHT, red/black soft cap, holding slender gold ceremonial staff on his right; QUEEN composed adult dark-haired crowned queen with white veil, face looking slightly LEFT, small yellow flower in RIGHT hand from original, red/black/gold gown and pearl necklace; KING mature gray-haired king with curled moustache and beard, gold crown, face almost frontal slightly LEFT, upright sword on viewer left, red/black/gold robe and ermine. Each wears small sapphire blue spade jewel brooch. Waist-up poses complete with hands and held objects visible, finish each sprite at a clean horizontal waistline, no legs, no pedestals, no decorative frame. Identical illustration scale, common baseline. 3 equal-width columns with 12 percent EMPTY margin around each entire character; absolutely no overlap, nothing crossing vertical 1/3 and 2/3 sheet boundaries. Canvas background uniform pure hot magenta RGB(255,0,255), #FF00FF, no gradients or shadows or pattern. Magenta is only a chroma-key background, NEVER clothing or reflected on character. No text, no labels, no ranks, no card outlines. Each portrait will be extracted as an independent sprite for code-composed white playing cards.

Exactly three isolated cartoon waist-up nobles, left to right JACK HEART, QUEEN HEART, KING HEART in strict equal-width thirds on wide landscape canvas. HEART JACK: clean-shaven youthful blond hair, clearly side profile facing RIGHT, red court cap and red/black gold brocade doublet, holding slender ceremonial staff feather-like finial. HEART QUEEN: pale composed adult queen with long dark hair and white veil, gold crown, near frontal face tilted slightly LEFT, holding single small five-petal yellow flower on viewer RIGHT, high ornate gold collar, ruby red gown with black/gold embroidery and pearls. Strict 3 equal columns, each entire figure fits within 84% of own column, EMPTY 8% margin each side, crowns and props do not cross cells. No overlap. NO cards, no rank letters, no text, no labels, no suit floating separately. Background perfectly uniform solid chroma-key HOT MAGENTA #FF00FF, no floor, no cast shadow, no gradient, no reflections from background. Preserve original palette of red black gold clothing, no magenta in subjects. Each will be mechanically cropped and composed at lower right of white playing card.
